title.en: Stack design: one layer or multiple layers?

subtitle.zh: 每层只承担自己最擅长的成像或刻蚀任务
subtitle.en: Each layer performs the imaging or etching task it does best

body.zh: 多层Stack不是单纯增加厚度，；而是逐级转换刻蚀化学与Mask耐受能力。
body.en: A multilayer Stack does more than add thickness:; it progressively changes etch chemistry and Mask resistance.

body.zh: 薄PR：利于分辨率，；但依赖下层HM
body.en: Thin PR: benefits resolution,; but relies on the underlying HM

body.zh: •层数增加：转移能力增强，；但CD Bias与缺陷会累积
body.en: • More layers: stronger transfer capability,; but CD Bias and defects accumulate

body.zh: • 更厚SOC：刻蚀寿命增加，；但Wiggling/应力风险；可能增大

body.zh: BARC或SiARC可能兼有光学与刻蚀功能，但不是所有ARC都能作为最终Hard Mask。
body.en: BARC or SiARC may provide both optical and etching functions, but not every ARC can act as the final Hard Mask.
